metaTitle: Custom Fleece Nursing Scrubs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom fleece nursing scrubs for your team. Warm, durable, and perfect for layering. Contact Perfect Imprints for bulk pricing.
introHtml: Fleece nursing scrubs offer warmth and comfort for healthcare professionals working in chilly environments. Unlike standard cotton scrubs, fleece provides insulation without bulk, making it ideal for layering over traditional uniforms. Whether you need quarter-zip pullovers or full-zip jackets, custom embroidery or screen printing can add your facility's logo. Perfect for hospital staff, clinics, or nursing schools looking for branded apparel that keeps teams cozy during long shifts.
heroAltText: Custom fleece nursing scrubs with embroidered logo, warm quarter-zip jacket for healthcare staff
